verdict.rationale: Jina Reader publishes a prebuilt container image of its open-source branch on GitHub Container Registry. The image bundles headless Chrome, LibreOffice, and CJK fonts, so developers can run the scraping service without building it. A self-hosted instance can also be pointed at an S3-compatible bucket for caching. Nothing documents production readiness: no deployment guide, scaling or configuration reference, or hardening advice. The image covers only the open-source branch, while features like the hosted proxy pool need the SaaS key. Missing for 10: production deployment documentation (scaling, configuration, health checks), clarity on feature parity between the open-source image and the hosted service, independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted production use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the scraping service via a Docker container for production use
